usage: 健身室 is a noun meaning 'gym'. It refers to a place equipped for physical exercise.
You can use 健身室 in sentences to talk about going to work out or exercising.
It often comes after verbs like '去' (go), '喺' (at), or '喺度' (here) to indicate location or action.
健身室 can be used with time phrases to specify when you go, e.g., '朝早去健身室' means 'go to the gym in the morning.'
It can also be modified by adjectives or classifiers, like '間' (measure word for rooms) — 一間健身室.
